configuration.arithmetic: strict; no relaxed or fast-math mode
notes: The SIMD-JIT uses direct AArch64 NEON implementations of the existing sin/cos and atan2 approximations.
Constant coefficients of +1 and -1 are lowered without a redundant multiply; other products retain fused multiply-add lowering.
Compilation, input construction, process startup, warmup, and final state readback are outside the timed region.
Unchecked means integrity publication checks are disabled; it does not enable relaxed arithmetic or NaN propagation.
